canonical_project: Baidu Intelligent Cloud Computing (Yangquan) Center - Phase 1
notes: Baidu's first large-scale self-built data center (Yangquan Economic Development Zone); phase 1 (RMB4.7bn, 12 ha, 160,000+ servers) delivered 2018; on 2021 national green-data-center list and 2022 national new-type-datacenter typical-case list; now being upgraded to intelligent-computing center supporting Baidu Ernie models.
